from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import hashlib,json,re
P=Path.cwd();R=P/'reports/research/510300_electricity_original_publication_state_v1'
objects=json.loads((R/'全部原报告收件与复用.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
if (R/'全部实际原统计区间.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('原区间已解析，不覆盖')
rows=[];binding=[];problems=[];bodies=[]
normal=lambda s:re.sub(r'\s+','',s).replace('—','-').replace('－','-').replace('–','-').replace('～','~').replace('〜','~')
def measure(text,label):
 patterns={'全社会':'全社会用电量','第一产业':'第一产业用电量','第二产业':'第二产业用电量','第三产业':'第三产业用电量','居民生活':'(?:城乡)?居民生活用电量'}
 pat=patterns[label]+r'[^；;。]{0,40}?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)亿千瓦时[^；;。]{0,25}?同比(增长|下降|减少|增加)(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%'
 m=re.search(pat,text)
 if not m:return None
 value=float(m.group(3))*(-1 if m.group(2) in ['下降','减少'] else 1)
 return {'amount_100m_kwh':float(m.group(1)),'reported_yoy_pct':value,'raw_fragment':m.group(0)}
for x in sorted(objects,key=lambda x:x['url']):
 if x.get('status_code')!=200:
  problems.append({'url':x['url'],'reason':'原请求未成功','request':x});continue
 b=(P/x['raw_path']).read_bytes()
 if hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()!=x['sha256']:raise RuntimeError('原响应hash改变')
 s=BeautifulSoup(b,'html.parser')
 date_node=s.select_one('.times')
 dt=date_node.get_text(' ',strip=True) if date_node else ''
 m=re.search(r'(20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})(?:\s+(\d{2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?))?',dt)
 if not m:
  problems.append({'url':x['url'],'reason':'原网页发布日期未定位','title':x['title']});continue
 pub=m.group(1);intraday=m.group(2) or 'UNKNOWN'
 year=int(pub[:4]);pubmonth=int(pub[5:7])
 body=s.select_one('.article-content') or s.select_one('#detail') or s.select_one('.article-box')
 if not body:
  problems.append({'url':x['url'],'reason':'原正文节点未定位'});continue
 for el in body.find_all(['script','style']):el.decompose()
 text=body.get_text('\n',strip=True)
 bodies.append({'url':x['url'],'publication_date':pub,'publication_time_intraday':intraday,'title':x['title'],'body_text':text,'raw_path':x['raw_path'],'sha256':x['sha256']})
 ps=[p.get_text(' ',strip=True) for p in body.find_all('p')]
 if not ps:ps=[text]
 ps=list(dict.fromkeys(ps))
 found=[]
 for p in ps:
  q=normal(p)
  if '全社会用电量' not in q or '第二产业用电量' not in q or '亿千瓦时' not in q:continue
  before=q.split('全社会用电量',1)[0]
  ranges=list(re.finditer(r'(?:(20\d{2})年)?(\d{1,2})[-~至](\d{1,2})月份?',before))
  singles=list(re.finditer(r'(?:(20\d{2})年)?(\d{1,2})月份?',before))
  kind=None;start=end=None;statyear=None;label=None
  if ranges:
   a=ranges[-1];statyear=int(a.group(1)) if a.group(1) else year;start=int(a.group(2));end=int(a.group(3));kind='CUMULATIVE_INTERVAL';label=a.group(0)
  elif singles:
   a=singles[-1];statyear=int(a.group(1)) if a.group(1) else year-(1 if int(a.group(2))>pubmonth else 0);start=end=int(a.group(2));kind='SINGLE_MONTH';label=a.group(0)
  else:
   annual=list(re.finditer(r'(20\d{2})年',before))
   if annual:statyear=int(annual[-1].group(1));start=1;end=12;kind='ANNUAL';label=annual[-1].group(0)
   elif '全年' in before:
    ty=re.search(r'(20\d{2})年',x['title'])
    if ty:statyear=int(ty.group(1));start=1;end=12;kind='ANNUAL';label='全年'
  if not kind or not(1<=start<=end<=12):
   problems.append({'url':x['url'],'reason':'段落原统计区间未自动定位，不填数','paragraph':p});continue
  stat_start=f'{statyear:04d}-{start:02d}';stat_end=f'{statyear:04d}-{end:02d}'
  if not ('2018-01'<=stat_start<=stat_end<='2025-12'):
   problems.append({'url':x['url'],'reason':'原统计区间在固定范围外','start':stat_start,'end':stat_end});continue
  fields={k:measure(q,k) for k in ['全社会','第一产业','第二产业','第三产业','居民生活']}
  if not fields['第二产业']:
   problems.append({'url':x['url'],'reason':'原第二产业量/同比未解析','paragraph':p});continue
  rec={'stat_period_start':stat_start,'stat_period_end':stat_end,'period_kind':kind,'period_months':end-start+1,'original_period_label':label,'measures':fields,'publication_date':pub,'publication_time_intraday':intraday,'directory_publishTime':x.get('directory_publishTime'),'decision_available_at_assumption':pub+'T23:59:59+08:00','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'source_url':x['url'],'source_title':x['title'],'raw_path':x['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':x['sha256'],'received_at':x['received_at'],'raw_period_paragraph':p,'original_cause_of_secondary_industry_change':'UNKNOWN'}
  rows.append(rec);found.append(rec)
 binding.append({'source_url':x['url'],'source_title':x['title'],'publication_date':pub,'publication_time_intraday':intraday,'directory_publishTime':x.get('directory_publishTime'),'raw_path':x['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':x['sha256'],'parsed_period_rows':len(found),'original_body_text_preserved':True})
def save(n,v):(R/n).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
save('全部实际原统计区间.json',rows)
save('全部原通报正文与日期.json',bodies)
save('全部原统计区间绑定.json',binding)
save('未成功请求与未解析原行.json',problems)
# 同公告最新单月优先，否则最新实际累计，不以收益值选择
selected=[];conflicts=[]
for x in objects:
 r=[a for a in rows if a['source_url']==x['url']]
 if not r:continue
 single=[a for a in r if a['period_kind']=='SINGLE_MONTH']
 pool=single or r
 latest=max(a['stat_period_end'] for a in pool)
 choices=[a for a in pool if a['stat_period_end']==latest]
 canonical={(a['period_kind'],a['period_months'],a['measures']['第二产业']['reported_yoy_pct']) for a in choices}
 if len(canonical)>1:
  conflicts.append({'url':x['url'],'reason':'同对象优先行冲突','choices':choices});continue
 z=dict(choices[0]);z['original_source_row_count']=len(r);selected.append(z)
save('每次原公告实际状态_不拼单月.json',sorted(selected,key=lambda a:(a['publication_date'],a['source_url'])))
save('原公告选择冲突.json',conflicts)
# 记录实际额外公开GET，不能把本应复用原件说成零新增请求
old=json.loads((P/'reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1/原公开收件_全部.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
oldrows=old.get('requests') or old.get('receipts') or old.get('objects') or []
dups=[]
for a in oldrows:
 for b in objects:
  if (a.get('url') or a.get('requested_url'))==b['url']:
   dups.append({'url':b['url'],'prior_status':a.get('http_status'),'new_status':b.get('status_code'),'prior_raw_sha256':a.get('sha256'),'new_raw_sha256':b.get('sha256'),'same_response_bytes':a.get('sha256')==b.get('sha256'),'actual_new_GET':1})
save('原件复用实现偏差_实际计数保持.json',{'finding':'采集器查旧收件status_code，但旧账本实际键为http_status，故两已有原对象未自动复用而各新增一次公开GET；每URL本研究仍只GET一次，未重试失败。两次冗余计入52报告请求，不伪称复用零请求。原协议及旧原件保留，当前原始对象按实际响应绑定。','duplicate_public_objects':dups,'source_or_model_definition_changed':False,'actual_new_original_report_GETs':len(objects),'new_models':0,'source_code_edits':0})
print(json.dumps({'成功原报告':len(binding),'原区间行':len(rows),'每公告状态':len(selected),'原周期类型':{k:sum(a['period_kind']==k for a in selected) for k in sorted(set(a['period_kind'] for a in selected))},'原状态公告最早':min(a['publication_date'] for a in selected),'最晚':max(a['publication_date'] for a in selected),'未成功或未解析记录':len(problems),'冲突':len(conflicts),'重复已有原件实际GET':len(dups)},ensure_ascii=False))
print('需保留未知的对象',json.dumps([{'url':x['url'],'reason':x['reason'],'paragraph':x.get('paragraph','')[:450]} for x in problems],ensure_ascii=False))
